description: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "EEC8E4184CD580F4C1E2B7AA264126EB", "You served at a temple to The Seven built from stone quarried by Kaelar hands on Sanctus. Each morning you rang the bells in solemn cadence, announcing the rising sun as a gift from Vyra, and each dusk you swept petals from the floor, left by those who still prayed. The gods were silent on this world, but the rituals lived on, and you helped keep them alive, a steward of belief without miracle.")
name: Riverlands_Kaelar_TempleCurate
